measure.C1a: every LEVEL feature of the replayed model carries per-parameter provenance: an elevation is SOURCE_EXACT only when it is a printed datum; a height is SOURCE_DERIVED only when it is the difference of two printed datums; a conventional value (2.80 storey height, extrapolated elevation, 2.72 clear height) is ASSUMED_FOR_RENDERING and named unresolved. Denominator: every LEVEL feature of every replayed model (no model = counted, reported apart).
measure.C1b: relation GROUND_CLEAR_HEIGHT: the printed vertical dimension from the finished floor of storey k (a printed datum row) to the underside of the slab under the printed floor of storey k+1. Final-model check: the non-top exterior walls of storey k have height = H (±0.01 m) and the slab band = floor(k+1) - H, with the dimension's evidence id recorded as USED_IN_MODEL; ends checked separately (bottom end on the floor datum row, top end below the next floor by a physically possible band 0.15-0.50 m). Where no such reading exists the model keeps the convention and names it.

tolerances.rowPx: max(4 px, 0.05 m at the section's ladder scale)
